facts.fact: Freetown City Council says its new digital property database holds more than 160,000 properties against 60,000 in the old one, and bills each property and business a Rate Demand Notice with a unique property or business number; the page is undated and the year 2020 is taken from its references to the 2020 tax year.

facts.fact: Freetown City Council says banks automatically credit payments to the owner's council account, so no cash-office receipt is needed, and that arrears from before the reform are being moved into the new property tax database; dated by the 2020 tax year.
facts.system: Freetown City Council property tax and business licence database

facts.fact: Freetown City Council holds the property and business records in its own database, with the council's rates and licence departments and an Enquiry and Appeals Desk working from them; the page does not say it reports to a national system.
